Hi Redwood team,

We just completed the self-serve sign-up for a Hosted API evaluation and would like to lock in a short demo plus sandbox access for two engineers. We're evaluating latency and throughput for a document-summarization flow.

Preferred windows next week (Pacific time):
- Tue 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 15:00–17:00 PT

Are there any quick prework items we should run through so the session is productive? If possible, please provision sandbox credentials that let both engineers run concurrent requests.

Thanks — looking forward to it,

Hi Caroline — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood. I'm Maya on the PLG ops side; I'll coordinate the demo + sandbox provisioning.

Thanks for the windows — those work. To make the session tightly scoped I recommend a 30-minute product walkthrough focused on the Hosted API quickstart, plus a separate 15-minute operations preflight where we provision keys and test a small load. Proposed booking options (all PT):
- Tue 10:30–11:00 (30m) + Tue 11:15–11:30 (15m ops preflight)
- Wed 15:15–15:45 (30m) + Wed 15:50–16:05 (15m ops preflight)

If you'd prefer both engineers in the same 30m walkthrough, we can do that instead — I recommend the 30+15 split for smoother credential handoff.

Prework (attached): redwood-quickstart.pdf and a short checklist (hostedapi-preflight.md). If you can paste one or two representative prompts or the approximate average doc length, Ben (building the demo prompts) can tune the example to match your workload.

Quick answers to your sandbox questions: we can provision two API keys for the sandbox and open a parallel request window for the eval. We'll include default guardrails; Diego will follow up with the actual credential file and calendar invite. If you need a short SLA/throughput bump for the session please flag it here and we'll pre-approve a temporary increase.

Actions:
- Confirm which proposed booking (Tue/Wed) you prefer
- Share 1–2 sample prompts or doc-lengths (optional)
- Diego to send calendar invite + sandbox credentials after confirmation

– Maya Srinivasan
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.com

Hi Caroline — thanks for confirming. I've booked the walkthrough + preflight on Wed as requested. Calendar invite attached and I've provisioned a sandbox bundle for Zentek: two API keys (one per engineer) and a temporary throughput bump for the evaluation window.

High-level answers:
- Concurrent requests: the sandbox keys are enabled for parallel work. For the live walkthrough we increased the sandbox request window to support ~50 concurrent requests across the account; for the demo we expect plenty of headroom. If you need sustained production-like throughput please flag it and we can open a temporary expanded quota.
- CORS / browser usage: the quickstart includes a small proxy pattern in the JS sample (see redwood-quickstart.pdf) — for security we do not recommend shipping secret keys in-browser. The sandbox keys are scoped and temporary; the preflight will cover safe test patterns.

Attachments provided:
- zentek-eval.ics (calendar invite stub)
- sandbox-credentials.txt (stub with two key placeholders)
- hostedapi-preflight.md (same checklist Maya attached)

Looking forward to the session — I'll drop a quick Ops note in the calendar event with the meeting link and breakout instructions.

Cheers,
